source.note: Kenney suv (FBX like car-sedan, car-taxi and car-police from the same kit and pin; the plan named the GLB member, which references Textures/colormap.png). Real size: the kit models every car about 1.3 units tall, so the scale is set per car. This one is a boxy two-door off-roader whose length is only 2.08x its height (a 4.6 m mid-size SUV is about 2.7x), so it cannot match a typical SUV in both height and length; it is matched to a short two-door 4x4 such as a Suzuki Jimny (about 3.5-3.65 x 1.65 x 1.72 m): 1.7 m tall, which makes it 3.53 m long with the rear spare wheel and 1.96 m wide across the mirrors (body about 1.7 m). Scaling to a 4.6 m length would make it 2.2 m tall. Kenney's green body is recoloured to the indigo script's amber-orange iris with the accent red as its shade (a colour no other library car uses; the shade stays clear of the ink outline), with the grey roof and rims in paper white, the grey rear quarter, grille and wheel-arch flares in near-black like tinted glass and trim, lamps in paper white and the practical. Wheels are separate nodes in the source; static, no clips.
